sysview.inquiry.title: Subject
sysview.inquiry.attachAppInfo: Attach app info (version, channel, OS — no personal data)

sysview.tour.main.menu.title: Menus
sysview.tour.main.menu.body: The File, Window, View and System menus. Open documents, arrange windows, change the view, and find logs and support.
sysview.tour.main.uiStyle.title: Layout mode
sysview.tour.main.uiStyle.body: Press Auto, PC, Tablet, or Mobile to switch right away. You can press another option even while Auto is on. Auto follows the window size.
sysview.tour.main.tabs.title: Document tabs
sysview.tour.main.tabs.body: Open documents appear as tabs. Press one to go to it. Right-click for the window menu (Restore, Minimize, Maximize, Move to Default Position, Close) plus Close Other Windows, Rename, Toggle MDI / Separate Window, and Toggle Pin.
sysview.tour.main.dock.title: Workspace
sysview.tour.main.dock.body: Document windows and panels live here. Drag a window to move it and drag its edges to resize it. Drag a panel title bar to move, merge, or split panels. The panel expand button appears when the mouse is near it (always shown on touch screens); press it to extend the panel to the window edge. Right-click a panel title bar or a tab inside it (on touch screens, the ▾ on the title bar) to open the position menu.
sysview.tour.main.docHelp.title: Document window help
sysview.tour.main.docHelp.body: Press ? on a document window's title bar to get the same walkthrough for that window.
sysview.tour.main.theme.title: Theme
sysview.tour.main.theme.body: Switch between the light and dark themes.
sysview.tour.main.settings.title: Settings
sysview.tour.main.settings.body: The Settings button opens the settings window, where appearance, window, language, layout and system settings live together.
sysview.tour.main.status.title: Status
sysview.tour.main.status.body: Shows how many documents are open.
sysview.tour.main.zoom.title: Zoom
sysview.tour.main.zoom.body: The active document's zoom. Use Ctrl+Wheel over a document to change it and Ctrl+0 to reset it.
sysview.tour.main.project.title: Project
sysview.tour.main.project.body: Choose the project to work on. Document windows with sync turned on follow this choice.
sysview.tour.doc.content.title: Document content
sysview.tour.doc.content.body: This window's content. Use Ctrl+Wheel to zoom this window only.
sysview.tour.doc.sdi.title: Detach window
sysview.tour.doc.sdi.body: Moves this document out of the main window into its own window. Press it again there to dock it back.
sysview.tour.doc.pin.title: Always on top
sysview.tour.doc.pin.body: Keeps this window in front of the others.
sysview.tour.doc.lock.title: Lock position
sysview.tour.doc.lock.body: Prevents this window from being moved or resized.
sysview.tour.doc.sync.title: Sync
sysview.tour.doc.sync.body: Makes this window follow the project chosen in the status bar.
sysview.tour.doc.dup.title: Allow duplicates
sysview.tour.doc.dup.body: Sets whether the same document can open in more than one window.
sysview.tour.doc.cache.title: Refresh
sysview.tour.doc.cache.body: Recreates this window at the same position, size and state.
sysview.tour.sdi.title.title: Detached window title bar
sysview.tour.sdi.title.body: This document window moves independently of the main window. Drag the title bar to move it, even to another monitor.
sysview.tour.sdi.redock.title: Dock to main window
sysview.tour.sdi.redock.body: Returns this window to the main window, at the spot it held before it was detached.
sysview.tour.settings.search.title: Find a setting
sysview.tour.settings.search.body: Type part of a name to keep only the matching settings.
sysview.tour.settings.categories.title: Categories
sysview.tour.settings.categories.body: Choose Appearance, Window, Language, Layout or System.
sysview.tour.settings.page.title: Settings
sysview.tour.settings.page.body: The settings in the chosen category. Changes apply and save right away.
sysview.tour.settings.reset.title: Reset this category
sysview.tour.settings.reset.body: Restores only this category's settings to their defaults.
sysview.tour.settings.resetAll.title: Reset all
sysview.tour.settings.resetAll.body: Restores every setting to its default.
sysview.tour.nav.drawer.title: Open the menu
sysview.tour.nav.drawer.body: Press ☰ to open the full menu.
sysview.tour.nav.docs.title: Choose a document
sysview.tour.nav.docs.body: Pick which open document to view.
sysview.tour.nav.notify.title: Notifications
sysview.tour.nav.close.title: Close document
sysview.tour.nav.close.body: Closes the document you are viewing.
sysview.tour.nav.tabs.title: Bottom tabs
sysview.tour.nav.tabs.body: Jump straight to frequently used screens.
sysview.tour.key.escClose: Close the active document window (when enabled in Settings). During help, exits help
sysview.tour.key.fontReset: Reset text size or window zoom
sysview.tour.key.wheelZoom: Change text size or window zoom over a document
sysview.tour.key.snapLeft: Snap the active window to the left half
sysview.tour.key.snapRight: Snap the active window to the right half
sysview.tour.key.snapRestore: Restore the active window to its previous size
sysview.tour.feature.start.title: Getting started
sysview.tour.feature.start.body: Open grid, Gantt and form documents from the File menu. Documents open inside the main window (MDI) or in their own window (SDI), and the Window menu switches between the two.
sysview.tour.feature.startNav.title: Getting started
sysview.tour.feature.startNav.body: Open grid, Gantt, and form documents from File in the ☰ menu. Choose among open documents from the list at the top.
sysview.tour.feature.window.title: Window management
sysview.tour.feature.window.body: Drag a title bar to move a window and drag its edges to resize it. A document window can go partly outside the work area, but part of its title bar always stays within reach. Right-click a title bar or tab and choose 'Move to Default Position' to bring a window back. Save the current layout under a name with the File menu's manual save, and load it again later.
sysview.tour.feature.autosave.title: Layout autosave
sysview.tour.feature.autosave.body: Your window arrangement is saved automatically and restored on the next run.
sysview.tour.feature.magnet.title: Magnet
sysview.tour.feature.magnet.body: When on, windows snap to each other's edges as you move them.
sysview.tour.feature.tray.title: Stay in tray
sysview.tour.feature.tray.body: When on, the app stays in the system tray after you close its window.
sysview.tour.feature.zoom.title: Document zoom
sysview.tour.feature.zoom.body: Set text size or window zoom separately for each document window.
sysview.tour.feature.panels.title: Panel split, merge, expand, and position
sysview.tour.feature.panels.body: All panels, including Explorer, Log, and Notifications, follow the same rules. Drag a title bar to move a panel to an edge, drop it on another panel to merge as tabs, or split beside another panel. Right-click the title bar and use 'Panel position' to choose top, bottom, left, right, or another panel. Right-click a tab and use 'Move this tab to' to move just that tab. On touch screens, the ▾ on the title bar opens 'Panel position', and you drag a tab to move it alone. The panel expand button appears when the mouse is near it (always shown on touch screens); press it to extend the panel to the window edge. Bring back a closed panel from the View menu.
sysview.tour.feature.settings.title: Settings window
sysview.tour.feature.settings.body: Open it from the System menu or the Settings button to change app settings in one place. Press F1 there for a walkthrough of that window.
sysview.help.contact.title: Contact
sysview.help.contact.body: Send questions or problems with 'Contact support' in the System menu. You can see what you sent in 'My requests'.
sysview.changelog.note: These release notes are built into the app. Once connected, the latest notes will come from the server.
sysview.changelog.r3.title: 2026-10-29 · PoC round 3
sysview.changelog.r3.body: Added the System menu (debug mode, log viewer and level, single-instance mode, GPU acceleration setting, app resource monitor, contact support and My requests, update check, help, about).
sysview.changelog.r2.title: 2026-10-28 · PoC round 2
sysview.changelog.r2.body: Added the Window menu, layout templates and personal layouts, magnet snapping, the notification panel, and live Korean/English switching.
sysview.changelog.r1.title: 2026-10-28 · PoC round 1
sysview.changelog.r1.body: Built the Avalonia + Dock shell with MDI and SDI window management and grid, Gantt, and form documents.
sysview.log.exportUnsupported: Saving to a file is not available here. Select lines in the list to copy them.
sysview.restart.nextLaunch: This setting takes effect the next time you start the app.
sysview.monitor.scope: Shows resources of this app process only. Server and database monitoring is done in the admin tool (pd-admin).
sysview.about.licenses.title: Open source notices
sysview.about.licenses.body: This program uses open source software such as Avalonia (MIT), Dock (MIT), and CommunityToolkit.Mvvm (MIT). Full notices will ship with the product.
